rubric: Read blind to all three instruments, text only (first ~600 characters, tails checked for six items). D: Y = describes the target as asserted content; H = describes it only hypothetically, conditionally or as an explicitly offered invented example; S = describes a different word instead; N = no description. R: Y = says it does not recognise the word or that the word is not an established/real thing. M (only when D is Y or H): Y = marks the description as invented, fictional, a guess or an interpretation; E = the only such mark is the word 'imaginary' in an imaginary-framed prompt; N = none.

borderline.25: identifies the target with a barn owl
borderline.51: treats target as a respelling of another word
borderline.74: 'usually imagined as' counted as a mark
